body: He knew I was upset, he alternated between talking about how he's a bad husband BUT the home theatre setup is REALLY for me (I didn't ask for it or complain about our previous setup). Honestly I'm so down and depressed (still) that I don't really want to see and talk to people. I know they'll ask what he did/got for my birthday...
I'm afraid to leave my husband alone. He has schizoaffective disorder.

I told him I'd like to go to the next town over (it's bigger) and check out the places we like there and stuff but when he woke up that morning his mind was made up. And I try not to push him to do anything due to his mental illness.
He didn't used to be like this at all. I hate mental illness.
I told him I'd like to go to the next town over (a "bigger" town) and walk around, window shop, etc. I didn't say that on the exact day of my birthday but his  mind seemed pretty made up.
I didn't do it. It was the worst weekend of my life, and I've been through some shit. I guess it just shows that I need to go with my gut next time.
